faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about dental care at Al Fawzy

q1.question: How long do dental implants last?
q1.answer: With proper care and maintenance, dental implants can last a lifetime. The titanium post integrates permanently with your jawbone, while the crown typically lasts 10-15 years before potentially needing replacement.

q2.question: Is teeth whitening safe?
q2.answer: Yes, professional teeth whitening at our clinic is completely safe. We use clinically tested whitening agents and protect your gums throughout the procedure. Results can last 1-3 years with proper maintenance.

q3.question: What are veneers and how long do they last?
q3.answer: Veneers are ultra-thin porcelain or composite shells bonded to the front of your teeth to improve appearance. E-max veneers typically last 10-20 years with proper care.

q4.question: How often should I visit the dentist?
q4.answer: We recommend visiting every 6 months for routine checkups and professional cleaning. Regular visits help detect issues early and maintain optimal oral health.

q5.question: Do you offer treatment for anxious patients?
q5.answer: Absolutely. We offer sedation dentistry (sleeping dentistry) where you can comfortably undergo multiple procedures in a single session under general anesthesia. Our team prioritizes your comfort.

q6.question: How do I book an appointment?
q6.answer: You can book via WhatsApp (+20 111 4444190), through our online booking system, or by calling us directly. Same-day appointments and emergency walk-ins are welcome.

q7.question: What is full mouth rehabilitation?
q7.answer: Full mouth rehabilitation is a comprehensive treatment that restores or replaces all teeth in the mouth. It addresses bite problems, decay, damaged teeth, and aesthetics in a coordinated treatment plan.

q8.question: Do you treat international patients?
q8.answer: Yes, we have a dedicated international patient program offering treatment coordination, accommodation recommendations, and transportation assistance. Our prices are 50-70% lower than US, UK, or Gulf countries.
